work_completed: Diagnosed linker errors for __isoc23_strtoull and __isoc23_strtoll when building NLTGovernanceSubsystem against the UE toolchain's glibc 2.28, caused by system <stdlib.h> redirecting strtoull/strtoll to C23 aliases unavailable in the older runtime
Added packages/asfdk/src/GLIBC23Compat.cpp with compatibility wrappers for __isoc23_strtoull, __isoc23_strtoll, and their _l locale variants, delegating to std::strtoull and std::strtoll
Replaced std::expected with tl::expected in packages/otoi/src/OTOIManager.cpp to match project convention
Added #undef strtoull/strtoll/strtol/strtoul around cstdlib includes in packages/include/nlohmann/json.hpp to avoid C23 symbol redirection
Removed unused m_toi member from packages/asfdk/include/asfdk/ASFDK.h and packages/asfdk/src/ASFDK.cpp
Created .gitignore to exclude build artifacts (*.o, lib/, etc.)
Committed all changes with NLT commit format: [kilo] fix(glibc23-compat): resolve __isoc23_strtoull/strtoll linker errors on glibc < 2.38
Created and pushed branch fix/glibc23-strtoull-compat to origin
Verified WorldEngine builds with the NLT Plugin with no problems by rebuilding WorldEngineEditor Linux Development via UBT — build succeeded
decisions_made: Used GLIBC23Compat.cpp wrapper approach instead of attempting to disable C23 feature macros via compiler flags, because UE toolchain predates glibc 2.38 and the missing symbols are referenced transitively through nlohmann/json.hpp
Kept json.hpp #undef edits as a secondary safeguard even though the primary fix is the compatibility object file
handoff_record.next_agent_notes: PR #35 is open for review. The fix is verified against the UE Linux toolchain (glibc 2.28) via a successful WorldEngineEditor build. If additional platforms are targeted (Windows/Mac), the GLIBC23Compat.cpp approach is Linux-specific and equivalent fixes may be needed for MSVC/Clang on those platforms.
tests_run: Rebuilt asfdk-cplus static library (libasfdk.a) with all object files including GLIBC23Compat.o
Rebuilt WorldEngineEditor Linux Development via UBT with NLTGovernanceSubsystem plugin linking against libasfdk.a — build succeeded with no linker errors
